title: Does the FULL D6 configuration read change application state the Button Test / D2 path depends on?

app.name: BIGBIGWON official Android app
app.framework: Flutter / Dart AOT (compressed pointers, arm64 android, null-safety)
app.analysis_mode: offline static only (no hardware, no BLE, no network)

classification_scope: 4.0.8 Button-Test / D2 (testModeSwitch) path, statically analysed surface
critical_framing_rule: This verdict is APP-side only. It states the app's Button-Test/D2 code has no app-state dependency on a prior D6 read. It does NOT claim the DEVICE requires or does-not-require D6 before answering D2.

d6_request_encoder.side_effect_on_app_state: NONE (builds frame, calls write() @0x80dd28; stores no config, sets no flag, notifies nothing)

d6_reply_consumers.note: The eight A4 14 D6 NN fragments are consumed ONLY by the config pages.
d6_reply_consumers.reassembly: _GrowableList::replaceRange / sublist over the accumulated buffer; result written via setUserConfig + ::writeDevice (gamepadset.dart)

d6_populated_app_state.note: D6-populated app state exists (positive control that the absence search is meaningful).

sender.state_reads: NONE (only the receiver used for write())

d2_enable_path.note_on_other_sites: The two config_stick_view sites and the gale_tab_keymap site guard only on a non-null captured context; none reads D6 state. gale wraps the argument in IsType_bool_Stub.

static_reads_in_rainbow_test.dart.name: ::curDevice
static_reads_in_rainbow_test.dart.use: device-identity enum for the device Image.asset in build

button_test_state_surface.static_reads_in_keybutton.dart: NONE (and no calls into bluetooth_mode/config functions)

PROVEN_STATIC: getDeviceConfig 0x80dbfc encodes A5 04 D6 7F with no app-state side effect
D6 fragments consumed by config pages' parsingData; ::protocolLength (0xb70) D6-written @0x826aa4
::protocolLength (0xb70) read by 18 app files, none in the Button-Test/D2 path
按键测试 ListTile built unconditionally in build @0x940554
More-page entry gate is BluetoothModel.field_3b connection state, not D6
testModeSwitch 0xabaef4 reads no state; write 0x80dd28 touches only the characteristic
rainbow_test.dart reads only statics 0xaf4 and 0x678; armorx_pro_more.dart reads none; keybutton.dart reads none
analysisData gate is frame[2]==2 and reads no config
curDevice (0xaf4) is never written by a D6 handler
STRONG_EVIDENCE: BluetoothModel.field_43 is a raw-notify broadcast stream fed by onCharacteristicChanged closure 0xacb7f8 (single producer observed)
INFERRED: framework static 0x678 is a WidgetsBinding-style framework binding (identical load pattern in flutter/src/widgets/heroes.dart, flutter/src/material/{ink_well,dropdown,scaffold}.dart)
UNKNOWN: internal byte layout of the 144-byte D6 payload (not needed for this question)
whether the DEVICE gates its D2 response on a prior D6 read (device-side, out of scope)

falsifiers: A LoadStaticField/LoadField in rainbow_test.dart, keybutton.dart, armorx_pro_more.dart, or testModeSwitch @0xabaef4 that resolves to a D6-written field (statics 0xb5c/0xb60/0xb70 or a config object member).
A branch in _ArmorXProMoreWidgetState::build @0x940554 or its route @0x94773c that skips the 按键测试 tile/route on a D6-derived value.
StoreStaticField(0xaf4) (curDevice) appearing in any D6 parse path rather than only in the three device-selection files.
BluetoothModel.field_43 being fed by the D6 parser rather than by onCharacteristicChanged's add(data).
A newer build inserting a D6-config read before the D2 send or before subscribeCharacteristic in the Button-Test path.
